articles.title: Really? New York stadium named the best place in America for food
articles.standfirst: Surprisingly, an MLB team based in New York has come in at No. 1 on a stadium food ranking.
articles.summary: Surprisingly, an MLB team based in New York has come in at No. 1 on a stadium food ranking.
articles.body:
When it comes to actually winning baseball games, there's only one MLB team that's actually been doing that consistently as of late: the New York Yankees . Unfortunately, the New York Mets can't say the same.

But there's one thing the Mets can say they do much better than the Yankees: Stadium food . Yelp recently ranked the Top 50 stadiums across the United States for gameday food , in all major sports, and Citi Field came in at No. 1 on the list.

Citi Field ranked as the best stadium for gameday eats in America by Yelp

Yelp had this to say about Citi Field, which features a large variety of different foods.

The concourse at Citi Field mirrors Queens itself, fast, lively, and full of surprises worth stopping for. This year’s 37 new menu items span 27 vendor partnerships, with The Queensboro’s Kimchi Reuben earning its place among the must-tries — house-cured corned beef, kimchi fennel, and Russian dressing stacked on toasted rye. For the bold and hungriest eaters, Willets Point Brewery’s 9-9-9 Challenge offers nine mini Nathan’s hot dogs and nine 4-ounce pours across nine innings, which is the kind of thing you sign up for confidently in the first inning and deeply reconsider by the fifth. With a spread this extensive, it makes sense that some Yelpers say 'I was really [just] there for the food.'

There are several enticing eats all around the stadium. While Shake Shack is one of the most notable restaurants there, Adam Richman's Burger Hall of Fame takes most of the plaudits when it comes to burgers.

There are also spots for Jamaican patties, BBQ, lobster rolls, sushi , and much more. Certainly, there are no shortage of different cuisines to choose from when visiting for a Mets home game.

Citi Field also features tons of alternative options for people with specific eating diets or habits. They have vegan and gluten friendly options, as well as kosher and vegetarian options.
